game.title: Final QA Before Ship
game.subtitle: You are the developer. Only the bug pass stands between you and release. Find the one defect in each build and ship it.
stage.stage01.name: Slime Hunting Grounds
stage.stage02.name: Magic Shop
intro.stage02.line: Shop build. Doubt the ledger too.
stage.stage03.name: Jump Dungeon
intro.stage03.line: Dungeon build. Doubt even how it feels to play.
stage.stage04.name: Room of Cards
intro.line: Build #1. One defect is on record. Find it and report it.
intro.hint: Some defects only surface when you play. Touch everything.
challenge.tutorial: Press when you are sure. You only get one report.
challenge.pickObject: Point at the object that's defective
category.title: What's wrong with it?
category.no-action.desc: Pressing or using it does nothing
category.weird-movement.desc: It moves in a strange way, direction, or speed
category.graphic.desc: Something looks wrong — shadow, color, shape
category.physics.desc: It passes through things or floats in the air
category.logic.desc: Numbers or rules don't add up
result.success.title: Defect confirmed
result.success.body: Accurate report. This build is signed off.
result.fail.title: False positive
result.fail.body: Report rejected. Rebuilding — a different defect will hide this time.
bug.E1.desc: Cards: one card wouldn't flip no matter how you clicked it.
bug.E2.desc: Cards: one card flipped vertically while every other card flipped sideways.
bug.E4.desc: Tries counter: it only went up once every two tries.
bug.E5.desc: Shuffle button: it played the shuffle motion but the cards never moved.
bug.E6.desc: Flower pot: it hovered in mid-air past the table's edge.
bug.E7.desc: Picture frame: the picture inside was hung upside down.
bug.E8.desc: Cards: one pair with clearly identical pictures refused to match.
bug.D1.desc: Jump pad (right): stepping on it didn't bounce you. The left one worked.
bug.D2.desc: Moving platform: on reaching its end, it teleported back instead of turning around.
bug.D3.desc: Torch (left): its light glowed in the wrong spot, away from the torch.
bug.D4.desc: Coins: one of them was half-buried inside the wall.
bug.D5.desc: Coin counter: it went up by 2 for every single coin.
bug.D6.desc: Player: gravity was halved only while falling. Rising was normal.
bug.D7.desc: Bat B: it flew around upside down.
bug.D8.desc: Spikes: stepping on them did no damage at all. The bats hurt, though.
bug.C1.desc: Shield: clicking it did nothing, while every other item worked.
bug.C2.desc: Cat: it only walked backwards, opposite to where it faced.
bug.C3.desc: Candle (left): the flame was burning downwards.
bug.C4.desc: Potion: it hovered in mid-air above the shelf and never fell.
bug.C5.desc: Gold: the apple was priced 3 gold but 7 gold was deducted.
bug.C6.desc: Inventory: the counter always showed one less than the real item count.
bug.C7.desc: Wall clock: the second hand was running backwards.
bug.B1.desc: Attack button: it showed a press effect but no attack came out.
bug.B2.desc: Slime B: it slid around without any walking animation.
bug.B3.desc: Player: the shadow was cast on the wrong side of the light source.
bug.B5.desc: Score display: it popped +10 but actually only added +1.
bug.B6.desc: Tree (left): the character could walk straight through it.
stage.stage05.name: All-Nighter Lab
intro.stage05.line: Lab build. Doubt even how time flows.
bug.F1.desc: Crystal: clicking it never dropped it into the cauldron. Other ingredients worked.
bug.F2.desc: Assistant robot: it bounced backwards every time it hit a wall.
bug.F3.desc: Fire: the flames were drawn on top of the cauldron instead of in front of it.
bug.F4.desc: Product shelf: potions landed in mid-air between the shelf slots.
bug.F5.desc: Stock counter: it dropped by 2 for every single ingredient used.
bug.F6.desc: Time remaining: the bar filled in 5s but the number hit 0 at 3s.
bug.F7.desc: Wall clock: the second hand ran at half the normal speed.
bug.F8.desc: Brew button: each brew took slightly longer than the one before.
bug.F9.desc: Window: one star outside stayed lit instead of twinkling.
stage.stage06.name: Basement Machine Room
intro.stage06.line: Shipping line build. Pull a lever to send a crate out its matching door. Doubt what moves what.
bug.G1.desc: Lever C: pulling it opened no door at all.
bug.G2.desc: Lever A: lever A opened door B and lever B opened door A. The wiring was swapped.
bug.G3.desc: Gears: two meshed gears turned in the same direction.
bug.G4.desc: Ceiling light: turning it on cast no shadows. Only the brightness changed.
bug.G5.desc: Valve: water kept flowing after closing it, even though the valve turned.
bug.G6.desc: Pressure gauge: the needle went down while water was flowing.
bug.G7.desc: Door B: it vanished and reappeared instead of sliding aside.
bug.G8.desc: Alarm light: it kept blinking regardless of the pressure.
bug.G9.desc: Plumber robot: it was drawn on top of the door frame when passing an open door.
bugdesc.noAction: {obj}: pressing it did nothing at all.
bugdesc.noCollision: {obj}: the character could walk straight through it.
bugdesc.floating: {obj}: it hovered in mid-air and never fell.
bugdesc.freezeAnimation: {obj}: it slid around without any movement animation.
bugdesc.reverseDirection: {obj}: it faced the opposite way from where it moved.
bugdesc.mirrorShadow: {obj}: its shadow fell on the wrong side of the light.
bugdesc.counterSkew: {counter}: it moved by a different amount than it displayed. ({obj})
stage.engine01.name: [Engine] Slime Hunting Grounds
bugdesc.speedScale: {obj}: it ran at half the normal speed.
bugdesc.teleportOnEnd: {obj}: on reaching its end it teleported back instead of turning around.
bugdesc.bounceOnEnd: {obj}: it recoiled backwards every time it hit the end.
bugdesc.offsetGlow: {obj}: its light glowed in the wrong spot, away from the object.
bugdesc.zSwap: {obj}: it was drawn on top of things it should be behind.
bugdesc.wiringSwap: {obj}: its wiring was swapped, so it operated the wrong target.
bugdesc.noBounce: {obj}: stepping on it did not bounce you.
result.dead.title: Build crashed
result.dead.body: Health ran out and the session ended. The defect went unreported.
ending.title: It shipped
ending.lead: All {total} builds verified. You caught the last defect, and the game went out on schedule.
ending.note: Your name isn't in the release notes. But not a single bug report came in.
bugdesc.invertMeter: {obj}: it moved the opposite way from the real value.
